errata.text: Pre-landing erratum (disclosed before any landing measurement). The frozen predicate's base arm named 'the same probe at the same revision against --tool tools/round-72/packed-elf.py reports 11 of 12 naming A12 false'. Measured at da6c17c1 it reports 8 of 12 (A2, A10, A11, A12 false): the route receipt is bound to the round-73 producer, so the round-72 route rejects it and its checker-mode children never run (receipt .ufo/waves/round-73/pre/c1-at-base.json). A12 therefore cannot be a route-differential at all: it measures the PROBE's channel, and passes whenever the genuine sub-run's checker accepts the receipt. The base arm is re-stipulated as the round-72 PROBE at the same revision and the same route receipt: 11 arms, 11 passed, no arm id A12_kernel_witness (.ufo/waves/round-73/pre/c1-at-base-r72probe.json), which is the world the round-73 probe must move with 12 of 12 and A12 true. The after-state target (12 of 12, A12 true, forged control convicted, grep '/proc/%d/environ' 3 in the round-73 probe against 0 in the round-72 one) and the kill rule are unchanged; no target was narrowed and the measured base value is reported, not hidden.

Pre-landing erratum, counting-command typo: the plan's counting line said the kernel-channel grep prints 0 in tools/round-72/seam-probe.py against 3 in tools/round-73/seam-probe.py. Measured with `grep -c '/proc/%d/environ' tools/round-72/seam-probe.py tools/round-73/seam-probe.py` it prints 0 against 1 (the string appears once, in `_proc_environ`; the poller `kernel_witness` reads the same file through that function). The predicate sentence in claims[0] does not carry this number; the measured values 0 and 1 are reported as-is.

Pre-landing erratum, gate finding INSTRUMENT_PIN_MISMATCH at the freeze: two loaded_by_counter rows named digests that are not the blobs at the measured revision (the round-72 route and the round-72 probe). The pins are corrected to the measured blobs; the old->new values are recorded in the round-73 lesson's Mistakes table and in the round report. The freeze gate is re-run at the record revision and must audit round-73 CLEAN.
